title: Two pointers: pair with a target sum
summary: In a sorted array, move a pointer in from each end to find two values that add up to the target.
note: The array is sorted and has at most one pair that adds up to the target.

narration.text: Put l at the first position and r at the last one, {r}.
l = {l} and r = {r} haven't met yet, so keep looking.
The pointers have met without finding a pair.
{s} is the target, {target}: found the pair.
{s} < {target}: the sum is too small, so move l right to a bigger value.
{s} > {target}: the sum is too big, so move r left to a smaller value.
No two values add up to {target}.
